name: verity-finance-zk
description: Minimum viable Circom/Groth16 proof for Verity Finance credit scoring

scripts.ptau:prepare: snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 build/pot12_0001.ptau build/pot12_final.ptau -v
scripts.setup: snarkjs groth16 setup build/credit_score.r1cs build/pot12_final.ptau build/credit_score_0000.zkey
scripts.zkey:verify: snarkjs zkey verify build/credit_score.r1cs build/pot12_final.ptau build/credit_score_final.zkey
scripts.export: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/credit_score_final.zkey build/verification_key.json && snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier build/credit_score_final.zkey contracts/VerityCreditScoreVerifier.sol
scripts.witness: npm run prepare-input && snarkjs wtns calculate build/credit_score_js/credit_score.wasm input.json build/witness.wtns
scripts.prove: npm run witness && snarkjs groth16 prove build/credit_score_final.zkey build/witness.wtns build/proof.json build/public.json
scripts.verify: snarkjs groth16 verify build/verification_key.json build/public.json build/proof.json
scripts.calldata: snarkjs zkey export soliditycalldata build/public.json build/proof.json
